transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because of elevators, mostly. I know in my head they’re not really dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get really scared—like I’m going to get trapped in there. I just can’t seem to make myself feel normal about it.
Do you avoid using elevators altogether, or do you only feel anxious in certain elevator situations?

I avoid them most of the time. Like at my apartment or on job sites, I’ll take the stairs if I can. If an elevator or lift is the only way up, I’ll usually ask to do something else, or I’ll only get on if someone I trust is right there with me.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious in other situations, like being in open spaces, crowded places, or going out alone without someone you trust?
Not really, no. I mean, crowded places aren’t my favorite, but I don’t get scared like that just going out or being in open spaces. It’s really the elevator thing that gets me.
When you’re in an elevator, do you ever experience sudden attacks of intense fear or discomfort, like your heart racing, sweating, or feeling like you can’t breathe?

Yeah. Pretty much right when the doors start closing, my chest tightens up and my hands get sweaty. I just get this strong feeling like, I need to get out right now, even if it’s only a couple floors.
Do you ever have these panic attacks when you’re not in an elevator or thinking about being in one?
No, I don’t think so. It’s really only when I’m in an elevator or know I have to get on one. Outside of that, I don’t really have those attacks.
When you're in an elevator, do you feel afraid that something bad, like getting trapped or having a panic attack, will happen specifically inside the elevator?
Yes. I know elevators aren’t really dangerous, but once I’m getting in one, I get scared I’m going to be trapped in there. It feels like I can’t calm myself down or make myself feel normal about it.
Have you ever had similar fears or avoidance with other enclosed spaces, like small rooms, tunnels, or public restrooms, or is this fear limited only to elevators?
It’s really just elevators. I mean, I know they’re not actually that dangerous, but when I have to get in one, I get scared I’m going to get trapped and I just can’t make myself feel normal about it.
Is your fear of elevators mainly about being trapped, or is it more about having a panic attack while inside one?

Mostly about being trapped. I get scared I’m going to be stuck in there, and even though I know elevators aren’t really dangerous, I just can’t make myself feel calm or normal once I’m getting in one.
